objectives.name: Cut Supply Lines
objectives.rulesText: At least 3 Imperial systems contain either a sabotage marker or a Rebel unit.

payload.note: StartOfRefresh objectives are checked at the start of Refresh — before retrieve, draw missions, advance-time, recruit/build, and deploy. If you satisfy the condition only after deploys (e.g. fresh units landed in Rebel-loyalty systems), the objective stays in hand and will be re-checked at the next Refresh.
